legalReading: Both pages verify the case number, document number, filing and entry date, timestamp, and pagination only.
The extracted body contains no caption, letter text, signature, property description, party position, or requested court action.

whyItMatters: The limitation prevents docket metadata from being promoted to body-verified evidence.
The missing letter may be relevant to the property-preservation dispute once recovered.
